main_text.p: IV. Appendix [?]Per sacerdotem quidem, cui sub capitis poenâ per superbiam resisti non vult Deus, intelligi potest summus sacerdos, vel Pontifex populi. Quo pacto poena contemptus & refragationis exasperatur, propter typum, quem ille gessit, Christi. Quemadmodum simili ratione sabba-thi violator morte multatus ex lege fuit, quòd sabbathum sacramentum esset inter Deum & populum, uti suo loco diximus. Verùm in antece-dentibus legis hujus nostræ, quæ ad sequen-tem librum de judiciis proprie pertinent, men-tio fit sacerdotum Levitarum in plurali. Et in-jurias sacerdotibus etiam, atque Apostolis quo-que illatas, gravissimè à Deo vindicatas fuisse, exempla jam allegata aliquot ostendunt. Ne ty-picum aliquid in illis etiam exemplis prætendi queat, quæ injurias Prophetis Dei illatas, earum-que severas ultiones continent. Unde evidentius morale aliquid in hac lege cernitur.
main_text.head: CAPUT XII.
De illis, qui parentibus vim, vel injuriam atro-cem inferunt.
main_text.p: Quemadmodum pro authoritate & digni-tate status ecclesiastici & politici, contra quascunque contumelias, injurias & suppressio-nes, sive privatas, sive publicas, tuendâ atque as-serendâ, aliquid jam dictum est: ita non omit-tendus hîc est status etiam œconomicus, utpote primus, antiquissimus, & reliquorum fons atque scaturigo, adeoque cæteris, & tempore, & digni-tate potior.

page.notes: Left margin notes are very small, cramped and partly cut off by the binding; only the first line is read with some confidence (marked [?]). The remaining marginal notes (references such as Zachariæ, Iehovæ, Paral. 26 v. 19, Ieroboami, Pappho, Adoni and others) could not be read reliably and are not transcribed. The heading "CAPUT XII." is printed as "CAPVT XI I." with the numeral split; read as XII. Several words are split at line ends with printed hyphens, kept as printed. The signature "Aa 5" is partly unclear.
